description.text: Core courses Principle of Marxist Philosophy, Principle of Marxist Political Economy, Political Science, World Political Economy and International Relations, Selected Classical Work of Marxism, Outline of Law, Marxist Ethics, Principle of Ideological and Political Education, Teaching Theory of Ideological and Political Education in Middle Schools and Contemporary China's Marxism. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-qualified specialized personnel who have higher political consciousness, ethical morality, and Marxism accomplishments; have the basic knowledge and theories of multi-disciplines such as philosophy, law, political science, management and pedagogy. After graduation, they will be able to work in intermediate schools and institutions of higher learning to teach the courses of Marxism Theory and Ideological and Political Education or do relevant researches work. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Law is granted.

duration.text: The Ideological and political education at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
